verdict.rationale: Conductor's own docs say it runs Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode, and the changelog describes a model loadout you can switch between with keyboard shortcuts. Users can also bring their own subscriptions or API keys per agent provider, so model choice spans multiple providers. Missing for 10: a documented list of the specific models available per provider, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the model switcher.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose which underlying AI model powers my session from multiple providers

citations.quote: Pick a loadout of your favorite models to quickly switch between.
Conductor lets you run Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode in parallel.
choose whether Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor use an API key or subscription
